name: TMX Tribe Router-minted USDG inflates TLP AUM
summary: TMX, a GMX-v1 fork on Arbitrum, made its public Router a manager of the Vault, so any user could mint USDG through Router.swap([token, USDG]). GlpManager prices TLP as pool AUM divided by TLP supply and does not subtract USDG minted outside GlpManager, so each such mint raised the TLP redemption price while the minted USDG stayed redeemable 1:1. The attacker looped mintAndStakeGlp, a Router USDG mint, unstakeAndRedeemGlp at the inflated price and sellUSDG, draining the Vault's USDT0, WBTC, WETH, wSOL and USDC.
notes: ProxyAdmin 0x3afdbef553d5c92817da37096bb2e47daeef951d.upgrade by the deployer selected Vault implementation 0x7f68594c7e9919c88e88fcd00b7f786cd6f45804, the code whose buyUSDG admitted the Router-manager mint in the anchor; it stayed active until block 419144004. The causal setting isManager(Router)=true was written earlier, at block 394937076 (Timelock tx 0x830d8cb8d863d057719d883bd6e3cb2f23b7a8a53792fff7b05c8c60e30a69d0, storage slot 0x67097c88c14e77814f8da4a2b94e1057d2715ac7351e8f248cb988361be24f05 0 -> 1), so this later code activation is the latest reset.

Components are the Vault's net ERC-20 outflow to the two attacker EOAs across all 445 successful attacker transactions that touched it (blocks 417530153-418024535): tokens the Vault sent them minus the tokens they deposited, so attacker-supplied loop capital is not counted and fees retained by the Vault reduce the figure. USDG nets to zero (minted and burned). The Jan 3-4 test runs from 0x16ed3aff lost 12.642473 USDT0 to the Vault and drew 0.00010844 WBTC; they are netted into the totals. Prices are DefiLlama historical quotes at the last Vault-touching transaction (timestamp 1767583146). The total matches the ~$1.4M reported by DarkNavy and QuillAudits. Later swaps, bridging and laundering by the attacker are not loss events.
Vault, Router and GlpManager implementations are unverified on Arbiscan; attribution rests on traces, view calls and storage diffs plus the DarkNavy analysis rather than source code.

GlpManager 0xe80fb6f907b37e2ed46a634882420b8e21bccfb1 (impl 0x2141dc7e3a50d177cdeadfb59fa50ffb17cd43d7, active since block 394932346), whose AUM omits external USDG, is not executed by the anchor and is not a separate target; its activation and the Router implementation activation (block 395320426) both precede this knot.
